stem.en: A model keeps saying "Calcutta is in France", and its builders want to fix this. Which repair could really work?

text.en: Tell it in a chat, so that it remembers the fact
Find the fact file inside it and edit that line
Add a rule that the model must always be correct
Correct the pile, then train the model again

explanation.en: What a model says comes from settings shaped by its pile, so a better pile and more training can change it. A chat changes no setting, there is no line inside the numbers to edit, and a model cannot follow a rule to be correct, because training only compares its guess with the pile.
